title: Lean core: regex, dashmap and parking_lot facades out of the pillar closure
goal: Remove third-party crates from the closure of the four pillars by replacing the regex, dashmap and parking_lot facade uses with std or small in-tree code with identical behaviour: the truth gate's static claim patterns on an in-tree matcher checked against the regex crate, the pillar locks on std-backed non-poisoning wrappers, the shared maps on std maps. Delete each facade nothing in the workspace uses any more and lower the lean-core ceilings to the measured values.
host: CEO laptop, CachyOS Linux x86_64, 28 threads, other agents compiling (load 12-16)
acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked --lib -p susi-paths -p susi-core -p susi-config -p susi-gawd-swarm -p susi-gawd-agents -p susi-gemi -p susi-gemi-models -p susi-gmcp -p susi-tools -p susi-daemon-runtime -p susi-daemon
cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test architecture_tests --test orphan_sources --test lean_core_ceilings --test core_docs_promise_no_ui_or_plugins --test no_github_coupling --test task_records
scripts/gmcp-record-evidence.sh and --mastery on the committed tree

results.differential: susi_core::pattern against regex 1.13.1 (scratch harness, not committed): 15,600,012 generated (pattern, text) pairs over the 12 static patterns, 0 unexplained differences; 5,919 differences, all on texts holding U+0301 or a superscript digit next to a keyword (the documented \b word-char rule); 2,200,000 checks on 10 small edge patterns (lazy/greedy, empty matches, $, alternation priority), 0 differences. Frozen as 30 table cases in pattern.rs tests.
results.speed: no-match scan of 1 MB texts: at most about 100 ms per pattern per MB on a loaded laptop (regex crate: under 10 ms); linear in the text
results.pillar_reach: measured on the merge with origin/main 5be3d0efb: third-party 161 -> 154 (aho-corasick, crossbeam-utils, dashmap, regex, regex-automata, regex-syntax, susi-os-unicode), workspace 44 -> 41, direct facade edges 19 -> 17
results.host_closure: cargo tree -p susi -e normal,build distinct packages 250 (origin/main 5be3d0efb) -> 243
results.lines: pillar line counts unchanged; GAWD's FAILURE token and gemi's local_plug locks were already moved off regex/parking_lot by T-AGYCLOUD-4 (5b6b04d22), whose versions this change keeps

limitations: \b in susi_core::pattern counts alphanumerics and _ as word chars; the regex crate's Unicode \w also counts combining marks, connector punctuation and the zero-width joiners, and not numbers outside Nd. They agree on every ASCII char.
parking_lot and tracing stay in the pillar closure through tokio/hyper (susi-http-transport, owned by lane nettransport); regex stays in the workspace as criterion's dev-dependency.
std locks are not eventually fair the way parking_lot's are; a poisoned lock is recovered exactly as parking_lot never poisoned.
